newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OCE SAYS NEW PRODUCTS WILL BOOST H2 RESULT.
newsitem.headline: OCE SAYS NEW PRODUCTS WILL BOOST H2 RESULT.

text.p: Printer and copier maker Oce said on Tuesday sales of new products were developing well and were expected to make a clear contribution to results in the second half of the year.

"Deliveries of the high-volume digital copier Oce 9700 are ...in full swing," the company said in a statement. "Particularly during the second half of 1997 the Oce 9700 will make a clear contribution to results."
In the office systems segment, Oce said it had built up a large order portfolio for its Oce 3165, a digital high-volume multifunctional network copier/printer.
"The Oce 3165 is expected to make a significant contribution particularly in the second half of 1997," it said.

Printing Systems, Oce's new business unit incorporating the printer activities acquired from Siemens last April, booked "excellent first quarter results" mainly due to demand for fanfold and cutsheet printers, Oce said.
It said the unit had booked a number of major orders in the first quarter.
The printer and copier maker, which earlier reported first-quarter net earnings up 62 percent at 44.3 million guilders, gave no fresh profit forecast for the full year.
Oce said at the presentation of 1996 results in February it expected growth in net profit to outstrip the expected sales growth of at least 19.9 percent.
First-quarter turnover rose 55 percent to 1.20 billion guilders, propelled mainly by acquisitions and favourable exchange rate effects.
